facts.text: Ilum, also later referred to as Starkiller Base due to the First Order military installation of the same name located on the planet, was a snow-covered planet located in the 7G sector of the Unknown Regions, originally located within the Ilum system.

evidence.quote: Ilum, also later referred to as Starkiller Base due to the First Order military installation of the same name located on the planet, was a snow-covered planet located in the 7G sector of the Unknown Regions, originally located within the Ilum system.

facts.text: While in the system, Ilum was the fifth planet from its parent star Asar, a blue dwarf, located roughly equidistant from Asar and the system's cometary cloud.

evidence.quote: While in the system, Ilum was the fifth planet from its parent star Asar, a blue dwarf, located roughly equidistant from Asar and the system's cometary cloud.

facts.text: When the Jedi Order was exterminated by order of Darth Sidious, the new Galactic Empire occupied Ilum and began excavating it for its vast supply of kyber crystals, which were to be used in the construction of the first and second Death Stars.
entities: DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station

evidence.quote: When the Jedi Order was exterminated by order of Darth Sidious, the new Galactic Empire occupied Ilum and began excavating it for its vast supply of kyber crystals, which were to be used in the construction of the first and second Death Stars.

facts.text: The over-mining of the planet caused its core, and later a massive Imperial Trench, to open up along Ilum's equator.

evidence.quote: The over-mining of the planet caused its core, and later a massive Imperial Trench, to open up along Ilum's equator.

facts.text: After the fall of the Empire, its successor state, the First Order, converted the massive trench into Starkiller Base: a system-destroying superweapon that was the culmination of the Empire's research into dark energy translations and hyperspace tunneling.

evidence.quote: After the fall of the Empire, its successor state, the First Order, converted the massive trench into Starkiller Base: a system-destroying superweapon that was the culmination of the Empire's research into dark energy translations and hyperspace tunneling.

facts.text: Held in secret by the First Order, its modifications allowed Ilum to act as a mobile base and major weapons platform until it was destroyed by the Resistance in desperation after Starkiller's destruction of the Hosnian system.

evidence.quote: Held in secret by the First Order, its modifications allowed Ilum to act as a mobile base and major weapons platform until it was destroyed by the Resistance in desperation after Starkiller's destruction of the Hosnian system.

facts.text: Following the attack, led by Poe Dameron, the planet collapsed into a star that would later be named Solo after the legendary smuggler Han Solo, who died at Ilum.

evidence.quote: Following the attack, led by Poe Dameron, the planet collapsed into a star that would later be named Solo after the legendary smuggler Han Solo, who died at Ilum.

facts.text: With a kyber crystalline core and a frigid climate, it was considered a planet despite its size.

evidence.quote: With a kyber crystalline core and a frigid climate, it was considered a planet despite its size.

facts.text: Ilum was an arctic world; nearly the entire planet was covered in ice and snow, and was therefore inhospitable to most species, though it was populated with non-sentient animals.
entities: Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know

evidence.quote: Ilum was an arctic world; nearly the entire planet was covered in ice and snow, and was therefore inhospitable to most species, though it was populated with non-sentient animals.

facts.text: Hidden beneath Ilum's frigid surface was what came to be known as the Crystal Cave.

evidence.quote: Hidden beneath Ilum's frigid surface was what came to be known as the Crystal Cave.

facts.text: Within the maze-like caves grew kyber crystals, which brought the Jedi Order to Ilum so they could harvest the crystals in a rite of passage known as the Gathering, in which Jedi initiates harvested their crystals by attuning themselves to the Force.

evidence.quote: Within the maze-like caves grew kyber crystals, which brought the Jedi Order to Ilum so they could harvest the crystals in a rite of passage known as the Gathering, in which Jedi initiates harvested their crystals by attuning themselves to the Force.

facts.text: Also located beneath the surface of Ilum were geysers, formed by volcanic activity on the planet.

evidence.quote: Also located beneath the surface of Ilum were geysers, formed by volcanic activity on the planet.

facts.text: These geysers warmed some bodies of water under the ice and their size or duration could change due to volcanic episodes or mineral deposition.

evidence.quote: These geysers warmed some bodies of water under the ice and their size or duration could change due to volcanic episodes or mineral deposition.

facts.text: Geological formations were also present in the caves of the planet, formed over billions of years by accumulated mineral matter, deposited from hydrothermal fluids.

evidence.quote: Geological formations were also present in the caves of the planet, formed over billions of years by accumulated mineral matter, deposited from hydrothermal fluids.

facts.text: By 18 BBY, the Empire had already corrupted Ilum, draining its resources dry as well as having destroyed entire parts of the planet's surface, as they were harvesting kyber crystals; the destruction was visible even from space.

evidence.quote: By 18 BBY, the Empire had already corrupted Ilum, draining its resources dry as well as having destroyed entire parts of the planet's surface, as they were harvesting kyber crystals; the destruction was visible even from space.

facts.text: When Great Jedi Purge survivor Ahsoka Tano returned to the planet, she noted that there were at least two Star Destroyers and a mining ship in orbit around the planet.

evidence.quote: When Great Jedi Purge survivor Ahsoka Tano returned to the planet, she noted that there were at least two Star Destroyers and a mining ship in orbit around the planet.

facts.text: Ilum's recorded history began tens of thousands of years before the Galactic Empire's creation.

evidence.quote: Ilum's recorded history began tens of thousands of years before the Galactic Empire's creation.

facts.text: Hyperspace surveyors mapped out an uninterrupted hyperspace route from the Core World of Metellos directly to Ilum, and was incredibly complex.

evidence.quote: Hyperspace surveyors mapped out an uninterrupted hyperspace route from the Core World of Metellos directly to Ilum, and was incredibly complex.

facts.text: The Jedi Temple on Ilum remained the last sign of intelligent life on Ilum, but was almost entirely covered by ice.

evidence.quote: The Jedi Temple on Ilum remained the last sign of intelligent life on Ilum, but was almost entirely covered by ice.
